title: Practice 1: Accusative endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Художник передала свои работы в ___ (общественный) достояние.
exercises.prompt: The artist released her works into the public domain.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «достояние»: accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I'll deliver the box.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «коробку»: accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Ты взял ___ (тёплый) одежду?
exercises.prompt: Did you bring any warm clothes?
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «одежду»: accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Don't look through the keyhole.
